clause: Painting tools: brush, pencil, mixer, color-replacement, pattern stamp [STU-RAS-024]

scope.summary: Implement the deduped core painting tools over the brush engine (MT-039): Brush (soft/antialiased foreground-color strokes with full dynamics); Pencil/pixel (hard-edged, aliased, pixel-aligned, with auto-erase to background over foreground pixels); Mixer brush (wet-paint mixing with canvas colors via wetness/load/mix/flow); Color-replacement brush (replacement color over sampled colors preserving texture/luminosity); Pattern stamp (paints a StudioPattern, optionally aligned/impressionist).
acceptance_criteria: brush/pencil/mixer/color-replacement/pattern-stamp all paint through the shared engine
expected_tests: live: brush + pencil strokes composite (antialiased vs aliased) via snapshot; pencil auto-erase reverts to background over foreground pixels
live: mixer brush blends canvas colors by wetness/load; color-replacement swaps hue while preserving luminosity

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Brush, pencil, mixer, color-replace & pattern stamp

risk_if_missed: No painting; the entire raster paint domain absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
